description: From your first line of telemetry to a full subsystem-based robot: build the Drivebase, Intake, Dumper, and Localization one lesson at a time, on one cooperative scheduler.

lessons.title: Welcome to the Pit
lessons.description: A quick tour of the PIT training station and how everything works.

lessons.title: FTC Robot Basics
lessons.description: What is inside an FTC robot, how matches work, and where you fit in as the programmer.

lessons.title: Your Code Package
lessons.description: Meet your one starter file and the three parts of every OpMode: init, start, and the run loop.

lessons.title: Hello, Telemetry
lessons.description: Show messages on the Driver Hub and watch the run loop tick, live.

lessons.title: Reading the Gamepad
lessons.description: Store a stick axis and a button in variables, then watch the live values change as you move the controller.

lessons.title: Tank Drive
lessons.description: Turn the left stick into left and right wheel power and make the robot drive like a tank.

lessons.title: Mecanum Drive
lessons.description: Replace tank drive with full mecanum: strafe sideways and rotate, then normalize the wheel powers.

lessons.title: IMU Heading
lessons.description: Add the Control Hub's IMU, read the robot's heading, show it live, and re-zero it with the right bumper.

lessons.title: From Messy Loop to Clean Class
lessons.description: Move the crowded inline drive code into its own Drivebase class, then collapse the OpMode loop down to two clean calls. Your first object-oriented refactor.

lessons.title: Field-Centric Driving
lessons.description: Make "forward" always mean away from the driver, no matter which way the robot faces.

lessons.title: Your First Mechanism: The Intake
lessons.description: Build a subsystem from an empty file: an enum-based state machine for the intake, with forward/reverse/off commands and two toggle buttons to drive it.

lessons.title: A Timed Machine: The Dumper
lessons.description: Your second subsystem and first TIMED state machine: one Y press raises the bucket, holds to dump, and lowers -- all without ever freezing the robot, using an ElapsedTime stopwatch instead of sleep(). Also reverses the servo (like a drive motor) so a bigger number tilts up.

lessons.title: Where Am I? Pinpoint Localization
lessons.description: Give the robot a sense of place: read x, y, and heading off a goBILDA Pinpoint smart sensor, share them through getters, and measure straight-line distance from the start with the Pythagorean theorem (Math.hypot).
